Lint Persistence Libraries API

Lint Persistence Libraries

The Lint Persistence Libraries provide build-time validation of JPA persistence artifacts — named JPQL queries, stored procedure declarations, and database schemas — without deploying the application. By compiling query strings against the entity metamodel and comparing the metamodel with a live database schema at build time, syntax errors, unknown entity references, invalid property paths, and schema mismatches are caught early.

Architecture

The library is organised around a two-level SPI hierarchy rooted in PersistenceLinter (the marker interface for all linting operations) and PersistenceLinterFactory (the base factory with ServiceLoader-based discovery):

  • NamedObjectParser / NamedObjectParserFactory — parses and validates named JPQL queries and stored procedure declarations, returning NamedObjectDescriptor results with parameter metadata.
  • SchemaValidator / SchemaValidatorFactory — validates the entity metamodel against a live database schema via JDBC.

Provider implementations for each JPA namespace are shipped in separate modules and are resolved at runtime by passing a JPA specification version (e.g. "3.1" or "2.2") to the appropriate factory method. The version is mapped internally to a persistence namespace ("jakarta" for JPA 3.x, "javax" for JPA 2.x).

What's New

Version 2.1.0

Version 2.1.0 introduces the unified linter hierarchy:

  • PersistenceLinter — marker interface that serves as the root type for all linting operations.
  • PersistenceLinterFactory — base factory with generic discovery via PersistenceLinterFactory.newPersistenceLinterFactory(String, Class).
  • SchemaValidator and SchemaValidatorFactory — new SPI for build-time database schema validation against the entity metamodel.

Version 2.0.0

Version 2.0.0 introduces the NamedObjectParser and NamedObjectParserFactory APIs, which replace the previous QueryParser and QueryParserFactory (now deprecated). The new API adds support for validating named stored procedures alongside named queries, and returns rich NamedObjectDescriptor results containing parameter metadata.

Modules

lint-persistence-api
Defines the Service Provider Interface (SPI): PersistenceLinter, PersistenceLinterFactory, NamedObjectParser, NamedObjectParserFactory, SchemaValidator, and SchemaValidatorFactory. This module contains no implementation; provider modules are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism. It also hosts the shared model types NamedObjectDescriptor and NamedObjectType.

The legacy persist.lint.query.spi package (QueryParser and QueryParserFactory) is deprecated in favour of the persist.lint.api.spi package.
lint-persistence-jakarta
Jakarta Persistence (JPA 3.x) provider. Uses Hibernate ORM 6 to compile JPQL queries into Semantic Query Model (SQM) trees and to validate database schemas.
Key classes: JakartaNamedObjectParserFactory, JakartaNamedObjectParser, JakartaSchemaValidatorFactory, and JakartaSchemaValidator.
lint-persistence-legacy
Legacy javax.persistence (JPA 2.x) provider. Uses Hibernate 5 and its AST-based query translator to validate JPQL queries and database schemas.
Key classes: LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory, LegacyNamedObjectParser, LegacySchemaValidatorFactory, and LegacySchemaValidator.
lint-persistence-bom
Bill of Materials (BOM) for convenient dependency management of all Lint Persistence modules.

Getting Started

Validating Named Queries and Stored Procedures

Use NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory(String) to obtain the appropriate factory for a given JPA specification version, then create a NamedObjectParser to validate named queries and stored procedures: 


    NamedObjectParserFactory factory = NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory("3.1");

    try (NamedObjectParser parser = factory.newNamedObjectParser(entityClassNames)) {

        // Validate a named query
        NamedObjectDescriptor queryDescriptor = parser.parseQuery(
            "Order.findByStatus",
            "SELECT o FROM Order o WHERE o.status = :status");

        // Validate a named stored procedure
        NamedObjectDescriptor procDescriptor = parser.parseStoredProcedure(
            "Order.archiveOldOrders",
            "sp_archive_orders",
            Set.of("cutoffDate", "archiveTable"));
    }

Validating Database Schemas

Use newSchemaValidatorFactory(String) to obtain a schema validator factory, then create a SchemaValidator and validate the entity metamodel against a live database: 


    SchemaValidatorFactory factory = SchemaValidatorFactory.newSchemaValidatorFactory("3.1");
    SchemaValidator validator = factory.newSchemaValidator(entityClassNames);

    validator.validateSchema(Map.of(
        "driver",   "org.h2.Driver",
        "url",      "jdbc:h2:mem:testdb",
        "username", "sa",
        "password", ""));

Generic Factory Discovery

The PersistenceLinterFactory.newPersistenceLinterFactory(String, Class) method provides a generic way to discover any linter factory subtype for a given JPA version: 


    // Equivalent to NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory("3.1")
    NamedObjectParserFactory parserFactory =
        PersistenceLinterFactory.newPersistenceLinterFactory("3.1", NamedObjectParserFactory.class);

    // Equivalent to SchemaValidatorFactory.newSchemaValidatorFactory("3.1")
    SchemaValidatorFactory schemaFactory =
        PersistenceLinterFactory.newPersistenceLinterFactory("3.1", SchemaValidatorFactory.class);
